d1.q: If you have a headache, you should ___ down and rest.
d1.explain: lie down 表示“躺下”，休息缓解头痛。

d1.q: He used to ___ late, but now he goes to bed early.
d1.explain: used to 后接动词原形。

d1.q: 'without' is followed by a verb in the -ing form.
d1.explain: without 是介词，后接动名词 doing。

d1.q: My brother has a ___ and needs to see a dentist.
d1.explain: 看牙医说明是 toothache 牙痛。

d1.q: You should take some ___ (medicine / medicines) and drink water.
d1.explain: medicine 表示药时不可数，不加 s。

d1.q: Which of the following are body parts?
d1.explain: fever 是症状不是身体部位。

d1.q: We say 'have a cold' to talk about a common illness.
d1.explain: have a cold 表示感冒。

d1.q: — I cut myself. — You should put a ___ on it.
d1.explain: 伤口应贴 bandage 绷带。

d1.q: He fell off the bike and ___ (hurt) his leg.
d1.explain: 过去式 hurt 与原形同形。

d1.q: You ___ smoke here; it is bad for your health.
d1.explain: 对健康有害，劝告不应该吸烟，用 shouldn't。

d2.q: She hopes ___ (help) others in the hospital.
The boy ___ (volunteer) at the hospital last summer.
d2.explain: last summer 用过去式 volunteered。

d2.q: Cheer up means to make someone happier.
d2.explain: cheer up 是“使振奋/使高兴起来”。

d2.q: Which of the following are phrasal verbs?
d2.explain: happy 是形容词不是短语动词。

d2.q: 'used to' describes a past habit that is no longer true.
d2.explain: used to 表示过去常常（现在不了）。

d2.q: They are going to ___ (give / hand) out food to the homeless.
A volunteer is a person who helps others ___ getting paid.
d2.explain: 志愿者是不计报酬帮助他人，without getting paid。

d2.q: The old man lives ___ (alone / lonely) but he doesn't feel lonely.
d2.explain: alone 表“独自”，lonely 表“孤独的（感受）”。

d2.q: We can raise ___ (money) for the children in need.
d2.explain: money 不可数，无复数形式。

d2.q: She ___ a book club for kids last year.
d2.explain: set up 表示“建立/创办”，符合创办读书俱乐部。

d3.q: — Could I borrow your pen? — ___ . Here you are.
Please ___ your bed after you get up.
d3.explain: 整理床铺用 make the bed。

d3.q: 'Could you please...?' is a polite way to make a request.
d3.explain: 用 could you please 提出请求更礼貌。

d3.q: I will help you ___ I finish my homework.
d3.explain: as soon as 表示“一……就……”。
take a walk 散步不是家务。

d3.q: Neither of the twins ___ (like / likes) doing dishes.
d3.explain: neither 作主语谓语用单数 likes。

d3.q: We use 'Could I...?' to ask for permission.
d3.explain: Could I...? 用来征求许可。

d3.q: — Could you please not make noise? — ___ .
d3.explain: 答应不吵闹用 Sure, I won't。

d3.q: It is important to share the housework with family ___ (member / members).
Doing chores helps children learn to ___ themselves.
d3.explain: look after 表示照顾自己。

d4.q: You should ___ (talk) to your parents about it.

d4.explain: encourage sb to do 鼓励某人做某事。

d4.q: 'so that' is used to express purpose.
d4.explain: so that 引导目的状语从句。

d4.q: He waited ___ his mother came back.
Which can be used in 'verb + sb. + to do'?
d4.explain: let sb do 用原形，不带 to。

d4.q: Why don't you ___ (write) him a letter?
d4.explain: Why don't you 后接动词原形。

d4.q: 'until' means up to the time when something happens.
d4.explain: until 意为直到某事发生。

d4.q: The best way to solve the problem is ___ to your teacher.
d4.explain: the way is to do 用不定式。

d4.q: He studies hard ___ (so that) he can get good grades.
d4.explain: so that 表示目的“以便”。

d4.q: Too much pressure is ___ for a child's health.
d4.explain: 压力过大会有害健康，用 bad。

d5.explain: 过去某一时刻正在进行的动作用过去进行时。

d5.q: ___ she was reading, her brother was playing.
d5.explain: 两个同时进行的长动作，用 While 连接。

d5.q: We use the past continuous to describe an action in progress at a past time.
d5.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某时正在进行的动作。

d5.q: What ___ you doing at this time yesterday?
Which use the past continuous correctly?
d5.explain: eat 应为 eating；we 配 were。

d5.q: When the teacher came in, the students ___ (talk).
d5.explain: 老师进来时学生正在说话，用过去进行时。

d5.q: 'when' can be used with a short action, 'while' with a longer action.
d5.explain: when 常接短动作，while 接长动作。

d5.q: The rain ___ (begin) while we were walking.
I saw a dog ___ (run) across the road when I was waiting.
d5.explain: see sb doing 看见某人正在做某事。

d5.q: This time yesterday we ___ a music class.
d5.explain: 昨天这个时候我们正在上音乐课，用过去进行时。

d6.q: The teacher told us a story. It ___ very interesting.
I will call you as soon as I ___ (arrive) home.
d6.explain: as soon as 主句将来，从句用一般现在时表将来。
decide to do 决定做某事。

d6.q: He kept ___ (work) hard and never gave up.
We use 'once upon a time' to begin a story.
d6.explain: once upon a time 用于故事开头“从前”。

d6.q: The man was ___ (strong) enough to carry the stone.
d6.explain: 原级 strong 即可，enough 放形容词后。

d6.q: ___ (As soon as) the sun rose, the birds began to sing.
d6.explain: As soon as 引导“一……就……”。

d6.q: The story teaches us to be ___ (brave) and never give up.
